text.tspan: !!! CLOSE 3V BEFORE CONNECTING !!!. -- DO NOT CLOSE 5V!.
Connects the TSC2007 touch controller's interrupt
output (/PENIRQ) to Arduino digital pin #2 on the shield
(which in your point-to-point wiring routes to GPIO4 on the Pi).
Without this bridge, the Pi cannot receive touch interrupt
signals — you would have to poll instead.
Connects the backlight LED transistor's base to
Arduino digital pin #3 (or, in your wiring, to the
J1 header so you can route it to GPIO13 on the Pi).
Without this solder bridge, the backlight is always
on at full brightness and you have no PWM control.
CUT / CLOSE ICSP JUMPERS in order to use D11-D12-D13 pins
!!! Note that the numbering is inverted from the J1 header numbering.
